cohort: 269 healthy pregnant women living in New York City from two cohorts: a) Thyroid Disruption And Infant Development (TDID) and b) Sibling/Hermanos cohort (S/H)
finding: Exposure to certain pesticides during pregnancy, specifically organophosphates like chlorpyrifos and the herbicide 2,4-D, was associated with decreased head circumference in boys and girls, respectively, while pyrethroid exposure was associated with increased head circumference in boys.
mod_finding: Delivery mode was considered as a covariate in the analysis of pesticide exposure and birth outcomes.
birth_weight: Measured but specific values not provided
